Problems and solution:
1. Dataset too large to read into memory at once -> Divide dataset into batches according to their file names, read a batch to train a mode, then save the model before reading data from another batch to continue training on the saved model.
2. Models inspired from the paper may not work entirely, found to cause exploding gradient -> modify by adding batch normalization between each graph layer.
3. Unsure of maximum threshold number of data that can be loaded into memory at once, but ~200 will fail, currently set at 128.
4. Verify invalid data containing NaN that causes problem during training.
